motionExceptions.reason: brief: "His closed happy eyes squint a touch as he lands" — these are already-closed happy eyes (drawn as arcs, not lids over pupils); the landing accent is a further squint dip (scaleY to 82%), not a blink-to-zero close.

brief: "Everything rests exactly where artwork 3 draws it" — the ribbon/swoosh/spark are stage-fixed decoration behind him ("sweeps in behind him"), not a held or worn prop; they hold their source position while the body bounces near them.
same as above — stage-fixed decoration, not welded to the body.

designer direction: the greens appear together as one smooth decorative gesture behind him when the celebration starts, then rest at the source position while he keeps bouncing; stage-fixed decoration, not a held prop.
same as above — pops at the gesture's end like a pen lift, then rests at the source position as stage decoration.
the gleam-clip geometry shares the ribbon's static stage position; see the ribbon exception.
same as above — both are stage-fixed decoration, not welded to each other or to the body.
same as above — stage-fixed decoration passing near the face, not welded to it.
same as above — stage-fixed decoration passing near the air-flow marks, not welded to them.
same as above — stage-fixed decoration passing near the face, not welded to it.

the swoosh reveals by a static-geometry pen draw-on while the spark pops around its own artwork centre at the wipe's end (scale-pivot gate), so their shared touching edge drifts a few px during the brief pop — an entrance artifact, not an independent clock.

brief: the air-flow marks are a motion-line VFX symbol ("AIR-FLOW HIGHLIGHTS — not arms, not antennae... exist only while he moves"), not a worn/contact part of the body — they float near the head with their own lagging swish and are exempt from the body-weld gate by the brief's own naming.

a glint sweeping a surface is relative motion the aliveness contract positively requires (motion-taste.md, contact-weld notes) — brief: "A soft light travels along the green ribbon like a reflection catching it."
